title: Mailroom Schedule: Envelope Charge on Policy-Number Amendments, Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing
content:
The policy-change envelope charge follows how the Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate travels and whether the filing's record shows a corrected refiling transmission sent today.

| Certificate travels by | Corrected refiling transmission of the filing sent today | Policy-change envelope charge |
|---|---|---|
| Paper mail | Yes — the amendment rides with that corrected refiling | 1.25 (enclosure) |
| Paper mail | No | 9.85 (certified mail) |
| Electronic transmission | Either | None |

How a certificate travels is its transmission method in the certificate's timetable. "Sent today" means a corrected refiling transmission on the filing's record dated today; one dated on an earlier day does not count.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- Paper-mail certificate with a corrected refiling transmission dated today: 1.25.
- Paper-mail certificate whose only corrected refiling was sent last month: 9.85.
- Electronic certificate: none.
